properties.notes: The site comprises a kennels and cattery business containing a residential dwelling, a number of kennel and cattery structures and an extensive area of grassland. Bounded by Gorse Hill and Donkey Lane to the north, east and south, and open countryside and a single residential dwelling to the west.
